message.content: Fuzzer found an energy violation — starting triage to isolate the cause.
Shrunk the case to a minimal trigger — now mapping the energy trajectory to pinpoint the break.
Spotted a close flyby that coincides with the energy spike — testing whether a finer integration step avoids it.
The finer timestep holds energy steady — now finalizing the diagnostic report.
